blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Simulation is a powerful tool for robotics, but building diverse, simulation-ready scenes at scale remains difficult. Reconstructing scenes from single images is a promising alternative, but visual similarity alone is insufficient: objects must also be recovered, accurately placed, and physically grounded. Existing methods that rely on post-hoc physics settling often misplace objects, producing scenes that look correct but behave poorly under manipulation. We present SceneRig, an agentic system that turns a single image into an editable, simulation-ready scene. SceneRig combines geometric, visual, and physical tools to reconstruct a faithful 3D scene. An agent then performs edit-and-validate loops inside a physics simulator to achieve physical stability. Across diverse inputs, SceneRig improves instance segmentation, object-centric appearance, and 3D placement while keeping the reconstructed scenes physically stable. Furthermore, SceneRig is effective for downstream robotics: its scenes predict real-robot policy outcomes more accurately than the baseline method and more reliably support replay of recorded manipulations without trajectory adaptation.
blocks.zh: 模拟是机器人的强大工具,但是在规模上建造多样的,模拟准备的场景仍然很困难. 从单一图像中重建场景是一个很有希望的替代方案,但光是视觉相似性是不够的:物体也必须被回收,准确放置,并被实际禁足. 依靠后热物理沉淀的现有方法常常会错置物体,产生看起来正确但行为不善的场景. 我们介绍SceneRig, 一个代理系统,将一个单一的图像变成一个可以编辑,模拟的场景。 SceneRig结合几何,视觉,和物理工具重建忠实的3D场景. 然后一个代理在物理模拟器内进行编辑与验证循环,以实现物理稳定性. 在各种投入中,SceneRig改进了实例分割,以对象为中心的外观,以及3D布置,同时保持重建后的场景物理稳定. 此外,SceneRig对下游机器人很有效:它的场景比基线方法更准确地预测了真机器人政策结果,并且更可靠地支持在不进行轨迹调整的情况下重播记录的操纵.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Evaluating the quality and robustness of action policies remains a fundamental bottleneck in robotics.
While physical execution is the gold standard, on-robot evaluations are notoriously difficult to scale: they demand expensive hardware, human supervision, and repeated trials across tasks and conditions [ li2024simpler ] .
Consequently, simulation is a powerful alternative that enables large-scale policy evaluation [ yang2026robolab ] .
However, scaling these environments remains difficult, as constructing realistic scenes requires substantial manual effort [ jain2025polaris ] .
blocks.zh:
评估行动政策的质量和稳健性仍然是机器人的一个根本瓶颈。
虽然实际执行是金本位,但机器人上的评价却臭名昭著地难以衡量:它们需要昂贵的硬件,人的监督,以及跨任务和条件的反复试验[li2024simpler].
因此,模拟是一种能够进行大规模政策评价的强有力的替代品[阳2026robolab]。
然而,扩大这些环境仍然很困难,因为构建现实的场景需要大量的人工努力[jain2025 polyis].

blocks.en:
Recent advances in agentic reconstruction and 3D generation have made real-to-sim scene reconstruction a promising route to scaling simulation environments [ viga2026 , chen2026sam3d , simfoundry2026 ] .
In fact, real-to-sim digital twins go beyond mere scaling: they capture the objects and arrangements of physical workspaces and let anyone turn a single photo into a simulation environment for policy evaluation.
Yet, despite recent progress in real-to-sim, balancing high-quality 3D reconstruction with faithful, robot-ready simulation physics remains challenging [ ma2026rest3d , chen2026agentic ] .
Even when a reconstruction is physically settled, objects can move away from their observed positions, producing a stable scene that no longer matches the robot’s workspace.
To bridge this gap, we propose SceneRig , an agentic system for simulation-ready 3D scene reconstruction from a single image. SceneRig addresses this problem by coupling image-guided pose refinement with physical validation for faithful trajectory replay and policy evaluation.
blocks.zh:
近期的代理重建与3D生成的进步,使真相相场景重建成为了缩小模拟环境的有希望的路径[viga2026, chen2026sam3d, simfoundry2026].
事实上,真到真数码双胞胎超越了单纯的缩放:它们捕捉物理工作空间的物体和安排,让任何人把一张照片变成一个模拟环境,用于政策评价.
然而,尽管近期在真对真方面取得了进步,但是在高质量3D重建与忠实,机器人准备模拟物理之间保持平衡仍然具有挑战性[ma2026rest3d,chen2026agentic].
即使重建在物理上已经安顿下来,物体也可以远离所观察到的位置,产生一个与机器人的工作空间不再相匹配的稳定场景.
为了弥补这一差距,我们提议使用SceneRig(SceneRig)这个代理系统,用于模拟准备3D场景从单一图像重建. SceneRig通过将图像制导的造型与对忠实的轨迹回放和政策评价的物理验证相结合来解决这个问题。

blocks.en:
Making this coupling effective requires the agent to inspect the effects of physical simulation and use that feedback to guide further corrections.
Even GPT-6 Astra struggles to achieve accurate, physically stable object placement through VIGA or a general-purpose coding agent when the reconstructed scenes are evaluated after physical settling (Table 4 ). SceneRig ’s core contribution is therefore a harness that connects the agent’s visual reasoning with geometric and physical tools for accurate, stable scene reconstruction. The agent uses the updated scene and feedback from the edit to decide what to investigate or correct next.
blocks.zh:
要使这种耦合有效,毒剂必须检查物理模拟的效果,并利用这些反馈指导进一步的校正.
即使是GPT-6 Astra在重建后的场景在进行物理沉淀后评价时,也会通过VIGA或通用编码剂来努力实现准确,身体稳定的物体放置(表4). 因此,SceneRig的核心贡献是将代理商的视觉推理与几何和物理工具联系起来,用于准确,稳定的场景重建. 代理商利用更新的场景和编辑时的反馈来决定下一步要调查或纠正什么.

blocks.en:
More concretely, SceneRig uses a flexible, modular harness with four stages.
First, SceneRig builds a relational scene graph , identifying objects and their support relationships.
Next, scene object creation uses 2D and 3D vision
models to estimate metric geometry and reconstruct object meshes. We then assign physical properties and initialize object placement through geometric alignment and support-ordered settling.
Third, specialized agents construct the surrounding geometry, materials, and lighting, with
strict rule-based verification gates for geometry and visual verification of all three.
Finally, and most importantly, SceneRig executes a physical edit-and-validate loop .
The agent selects which object to adjust and whether to change its position, scale, or orientation; geometric and physical tools search for an adjustment and test its effects in simulation.
Although the current implementation leverages specific state-of-the-art models, SceneRig is designed to incorporate future foundation models.
blocks.zh:
更具体地说,SceneRig采用了有四个阶段的灵活而模块化的牵引.
首先,SceneRig构建一个关系场景图,识别对象及其支持关系.
接下来, 场景对象创建使用 2D 和 3D 视觉

第三,专门物剂建造周围几何、材料和照明装置。
严格基于规则的几何验证门和所有三种的视觉验证门。
最后,最重要的是,SceneRig执行一个物理编辑和验证循环.
代理选择哪个对象反对调整以及是否改变其位置、尺度或取向;几何和物理工具搜索调整并在模拟中测试其效果。
虽然目前的实施利用了具体的最新模式,但SceneRig的设计是纳入未来的基础模式.

blocks.en:
We evaluate SceneRig on diverse images, spanning synthetic renderings, real robot workspaces, AI-generated images, and in-the-wild smartphone captures.
We demonstrate that SceneRig improves instance segmentation, object-centric appearance, and 3D object placement over existing methods, with all evaluated scenes passing physical stability checks (Tables 1 , 2 ).
Beyond geometric reconstruction, we show that SceneRig yields robot-ready environments (Figure 1 ), supporting both real-to-sim policy evaluation and open-loop trajectory replay.
In summary, our contributions are: • We introduce SceneRig , an agentic system that reconstructs simulation-ready digital twins from a single image, prioritizing physical grounding in addition to visual similarity. • We build a modular harness that equips agents with geometric and physical tools.
Through iterative edit-and-validate loops, SceneRig directly incorporates physics into pose refinement. • SceneRig improves reconstruction quality and robotics performance over single-image real-to-sim systems. Compared with the baseline, it increases open-loop trajectory replay success from 36% to 80% and episode-level agreement with real-world policy result from 54% to 69%.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Single-Image Scene Reconstruction. Object-centric reconstruction recovers individual objects and their spatial arrangement. Supervised methods predict geometry or retrieve assets: Total3D [ nie2020total3d ] predicts indoor layout and meshes, while ROCA [ gumerli2022roca ] retrieves and aligns CAD models. Without object annotations, uORF [ yu2022uorf ] and uOCF [ luo2024uocf ] learn compositional neural fields from multi-view images to separate objects and backgrounds. For explicit meshes, generative methods reconstruct instances separately and align them [ dogaru2025gen3dsr , zhou2024dpa , han2025reparo , zhao2025depr ] , while MIDI [ huang2025midi ] jointly generates multiple objects. CAST [ yao2025cast ] combines occlusion-completed object generation with pose refinement using scene relations and signed-distance constraints. SAM3D [ chen2026sam3d ] predicts object geometry, texture, and camera-relative layout. However, visual fidelity alone does not ensure physical stability or readiness for simulation.
blocks.zh: 单相相景重建. 以物体为中心的重建可以恢复单个物体及其空间安排. 被监督的方法预测出几何或取回资产: Total3D [nie2020 total3d] 预测室内布局和 meshes,而ROCA [gumerli2022roca] 检索并校正 CAD 模型. 没有对象说明,uORF [yu2022uorf] 和uOCF [luo2024uocf] 从多视图图像中学习组成神经字段,以区分对象和背景. 对于显性 meshes,基因方法将实例分别重建并组合起来[dogaru2025gen3dsr.,zhou2024dpa.han2025reparo.,zhao2025depr],而MIDI [huang2025midi]联合生成多个对象. CAST [yao2025cast]结合了被封装完成的物体生成,并使用场景关系和签名-距离限制来进行姿势改进. SAM3D [chen2026sam3d]预测出物体几何,纹理,相机相接的布局. 然而,仅凭视觉忠贞并不能确保身体稳定性或模拟准备。

blocks.en:
Agentic 3D Scene Creation. VLM agents construct 3D scenes through tool use and iterative feedback [ hu2024scenecraft , huang2024blenderalchemy ] . To ground generation and editing in scene structure, liu2025agentic3d maintain labeled point clouds and scene relations. SceneWeaver [ yang2025sceneweaver ] adaptively selects synthesis and editing tools, while Scenethesis [ ling2025scenethesis ] combines language-based planning with generated-image guidance and geometric constraints. Beyond planning and tool selection, SAGE [ xia2026sage ] and SceneSmith [ pfaff2026scenesmith ] use editor-critic loops for indoor scene generation.
For precise placement, agents also use numerical solvers [ yang2024holodeck , sun2025layoutvlm , wang2026physcensis ] .
blocks.zh:
代理3D场景创作. VLM代理通过工具使用和迭代反馈构建出3D场景[hu2024scenecraft.,huang2024blenderalchemy]. 为了在场景结构中进行地面生成和编辑,liu2025agentic3d保持被标注的点云和场景关系. SceneWeaver [yang2025 scenewever] 适应性地选择了合成和编辑工具,而Scenethesis [ling2025 scenethesis] 将基于语言的规划与生成-图像的引导和几何限制结合起来. 除了规划和工具选择,SAGE [xia2026sage]和SceneSmith [pfaff2026scenesmith]使用编辑-批评回路进行室内场景生成.
为精确定位,剂也使用数值解析器[阳平2024holodeck., sun2025layoutvlm., wang2026physcensis].

blocks.en: Agentic workflows also support reconstruction from visual references. VIGA [ viga2026 ] reconstructs 3D scenes with a generator–verifier loop, while SEIG [ seig2026 ] extends this approach to refine geometry, materials, and lighting sequentially. SceneConductor [ kim2026sceneconductor ] initializes layouts, builds environments from point maps, and delegates local corrections to specialist agents. For evaluation, BlenderGym [ gu2025blendergym ] benchmarks graphics editing, while IR3D-Bench [ liu2025ir3dbench ] evaluates scene understanding through agentic inverse rendering. In contrast, SceneRig ’s agent corrects objects using geometry- and physics-grounded tools.
blocks.zh: 代理工作流程也支持从可视参考进行重建. VIGA [viga2026] 以生成器-验证器回路来重建3D场景,而SEIG [seig2026] 则将这一方法延伸至精细几何,材料,并依次进行照明. 场景制取器 [kim2026scene导出器]初始化布局,从点地图构建环境,将地方矫正工作委托给专家代理. 对于评价,BlenderGym [gu2025blendergym]基准图形编辑,而IR3D-Bench [liu2025ir3dbench]通过代理反向渲染评价场景理解. 相形之下,SceneRig的代理用几何和物理基底工具来校正物体.

blocks.en: Physically Grounded Real-to-Sim. Real-to-sim aims at building interactive environments for robot learning and evaluation. RialTo [ torne2024rialto ] , Re3Sim [ han2025re3sim ] , and HoloScene [ xia2025holoscene ] recover interactive assets from video or scans. Agentic Real2Sim [ chen2026agentic ] turns a recorded robot–object interaction into a simulatable twin. Our closest baseline, SimFoundry [ simfoundry2026 ] , reconstructs editable digital twins from video and generates digital cousins for real-to-sim policy evaluation and sim-to-real policy training. For data generation without dynamics simulation, Real2Render2Real [ yu2025real2render2real ] renders robot training images from scans.
blocks.zh: 物理地基实相相. Real-to-sim旨在为机器人的学习和评价建立互动环境. Rialto [torne2024rialto], Re3Sim [han2025re3sim],和HoloScene [xia2025holoscene] 从视频或扫描中取回交互式资产. Agentic Real2Sim [chen2026 agentic] 将一个被记录的机器人-对象交互变为可模拟的双胞胎. 我们最近的基线SimFoundry[simfoundry2026],从视频中重建可编辑的数字双胞胎,并生成数字表兄弟,用于实到实政策评价与实政策培训. 对于没有动态模拟的数据生成,Real2Render2 Real [yu2025real2real]使机器人训练图像从扫描得到.

blocks.en: Concurrent single-image methods use several correction strategies. TableVerse [ tableverse2026 ] resolves collisions through geometric translations before settling; ϕ \phi -Scene [ li2026phiscene ] optimizes clearance and settles objects in support order. REST3D [ ma2026rest3d ] optimizes poses with cross-entropy optimization, while RoboSnap [ zhang2026robosnap ] alternates signed-distance optimization with settling. SimuScene [ lee2026simuscene ] uses simulated displacement to trigger shape stretching or regeneration. In SceneRig , an agent identifies misplaced objects and calls geometry- and physics-grounded tools to correct them. These tools search for pose adjustments and test edits in simulation, returning feedback to guide further inspection and correction.
blocks.zh: 同时期的单相平面平面方法使用几种校正策略. 表Verse [tableverse2026]在定居前通过几何翻译解决相撞问题;\\\phi-Scene [li2026phiscene] 优化清理,并按支持顺序结算对象. REST3D [ma2026rest3d] 优化姿势与跨入优化,而RoboSnap [zhang2026robosnap] 副手以安放方式签名-距离优化. SimuScene [lee2026simuscene] 使用模拟置放来触发形状拉伸或再生. 在 SceneRig 中,一个代理识别出错误的物体,并调用几何和物理定位的工具进行校正. 这些工具在模拟中寻找设置调整并测试编辑,返回反馈来指导进一步检查和校正.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Given a single RGB image, we reconstruct an editable, simulation-ready 3D scene that matches its appearance and object arrangement. The system primarily targets tabletop scenes for robotics and can also process room scenes by treating the floor as the main support surface.
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个单一的RGB图像,我们重建了一个可编辑的,模拟准备的3D场景,与它的外观和对象安排相匹配. 系统主要针对机器人的台上场景,也可以通过将地板作为主要支持面来处理房间场景.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Overview of SceneRig . From a single image, SceneRig recovers objects, supporting surfaces, and their relations, and initializes a gravity-aligned metric scene through physical settling. Geometry, material, and lighting agents construct the surrounding scene. Finally, a pose-refinement agent inspects paired reference/render crops and invokes geometry- and physics-grounded tools to correct object placement.
blocks.zh: 图2:SceneRig概况. 从一幅图像中,SceneRig恢复了物体,支持表面,及其关系,并通过物理沉淀来初始化重力相接的度量场景. 几何、材料和照明剂构成周围的场景。 最后,一种活性精炼剂检查成对的参考物/还原作物并使用几何和物理基入的工具来纠正物体的放置.

blocks.en: 3.1 Relational and Metric Initialization
blocks.zh: 3.1 关系和医学初始化

blocks.en: We first recover which entities are present, how they support one another, and where they lie in metric 3D. This relational and geometric evidence guides object reconstruction and physical settling.
blocks.zh: 我们首先恢复了哪些实体存在,它们如何相互支持,它们存在于衡量3D中。 这种关系和几何证据指导物体的重建和实物结算。

blocks.en: Relational parsing. A VLM proposes movable objects 𝒪 \mathcal{O} , root surfaces ℛ \mathcal{R} , and their support and structural relations, with a distinct description for each instance. MolmoPoint [ molmopoint ] localizes each entity from its description, and its predicted points select instance masks from SAM3 [ sam3 ] candidates for that category. Subsequent checks recover objects omitted from the initial inventory, repair split or merged masks, and revise root surfaces and their relations. For occluded objects, we optionally remove foreground occluders with LanPaint [ zheng2025lanpaint ] and re-segment the target. Entity identities persist throughout reconstruction (Appendix ).
blocks.zh: 关系解说. 一个 VLM 提出可移动对象 O\ mathcal{O}, 根表面 R\ mathcal{R}, 以及它们的支持和结构关系, 每个实例都有不同的描述 。 MollmoPoint [mollmopoint]将每个实体从其描述中本地化,其所预测的点从SAM3[sam3]候选者中选择实例口罩. 随后的检查会取回初始库存中遗漏的物件,修复分拆或合并口罩,并修改根面及其关系. 对于被封禁的物体,我们可选择地去除与"兰花" [zheng2025lanpaint]的前地被封禁者,并重新将目标隔离. 在整个重建过程中,实体身份持续存在(附录)。

blocks.en: Metric initialization. The scene graph tells us what is present and how entities are related, but not their metric placement in 3D. We use MoGe-2 [ wang2025moge2 ] to estimate camera intrinsics and a dense metric 3D point map. When metric depth and calibrated intrinsics are available, such as from a robot’s RGB-D camera, they replace these estimates. A plane fitted to the main support defines a gravity-aligned coordinate frame in which the support lies at z = 0 z=0 . Fitted planes and estimated contact geometry also provide geometric evidence for validating the proposed scene relations. SAM3D [ chen2026sam3d ] reconstructs each movable object’s mesh and appearance from the image and its instance mask. We initialize its transform by translating and uniformly scaling the mesh to align with the corresponding metric 3D points. Finally, we estimate the physical properties for simulation following SceneSmith [ pfaff2026scenesmith ] .
blocks.zh: 计量初始化. 场景图告诉我们什么是现在的,以及实体是如何关联的,但并没有说明它们放在了3D中的度量. 我们用MoGe-2 [wang2025moge2]来估计相机的内在特征和密集的公制三维点图. 当有测量深度和校正的内在元素,例如机器人的RGB-D相机时,它们会取代这些估计值. 与主支撑相配的平面定义了重力相配的坐标框架,支撑在z=0 z=0. 已装配的平面和估计的接触几何也提供了几何证据来验证拟议的场景关系. SAM3D [chen2026sam3d] 重建了每个可移动物体的网格和从图像及其实例口罩的外观. 我们通过翻译和统一缩放网格来初始化其转换,以便与相应的公分3D点相匹配. 最后,我们估计在SceneSmith [pfaff2026scenesmith]之后模拟的物理属性.

blocks.en:
Support-ordered physical settling. With the support graph and metric object estimates in place, we settle the reconstructed objects while preserving their observed arrangement. Settling the full scene at once can cause objects to drift, topple, or resolve collisions in ways that differ from the image evidence. Thus, we settle objects in parent-before-child order under G G . Each object is placed against its support and previously settled objects and simulated with PhysX in Isaac Sim. We then use ICP (adjusting translation, scale, and yaw) to improve alignment with its masked 3D observations and simulate it again.
Guarded fallbacks may adjust collision geometry and physical properties to obtain a resting configuration; Appendix details these adjustments and the validation procedure.
blocks.zh:
支持令实际安放. 有了支持图和度量物体估计值,我们就在保存观测到的物体安排的同时,对已重建的物体进行结算。 将整个场景一并固定,可以使物体以与图像证据不同的方式漂移,倒置,或解决相撞. 因此,我们在GG下按父子前顺序处理物品。 每个物体被置于其支持和先前已安放的物体上并被以艾萨克·西姆(英语:Isaac Sim)的PhysX所模拟. 然后,我们使用国际比较方案(调整翻译、规模和yaw)来改进与其被遮住的三维观测数据的一致性,并再次模拟。
防守后退可以调整相撞几何和物理性质以获得休息配置;附录详细介绍了这些调整和验证程序.

blocks.en: 3.2 Agentic Scene Construction
blocks.zh: 3.2 活性场景建筑

blocks.en: With objects settled, we reconstruct root geometry ( M r , X r ) (M_{r},X_{r}) , materials τ r \tau_{r} , and lighting L L in separate stages sharing a persistent Blender scene. Following SEIG [ seig2026 ] , each stage edits one variable group. It pairs an editing agent with an independent verifier, both of which receive the scene graph, the current scene snapshot, and the permitted edits. The editor modifies scene code and renders the result, and the verifier compares the render with the reference image, then approves it or requests corrections within the same scope. Each revision continues from the updated scene, preserving earlier work across iterations and stages.
blocks.zh: 随着物体的确定,我们重建了根几何(M r, X r) (M_{r}, X_{r}), 材料\ r\ tau_{r}, 并分出不同阶段点亮 L L , 共享一个持久的 Blender 场景 。 继SEIG [seig2026]后,每个阶段会编辑一个可变组. 它将编辑代理与独立的核查者配对,两者都接收了场景图,当前场景快照,以及允许的编辑. 编辑器修改了场景代码并做出结果,验证者将渲染与参考图像进行比较,然后批准或请求在同一范围内进行更正. 每次修订都从更新的场景继续,保留了早期的迭代和相接阶段的工作.

blocks.en: Scene structure. The geometry agent constructs root surfaces in ℛ \mathcal{R} as static colliders, positioning and orienting them with RANSAC-fitted planes and inferring their shapes and sizes from the input image; they must satisfy the required relations in E surf E_{\mathrm{surf}} . Imported object geometry and appearance remain fixed; objects move only to correct measured contact defects or clear position mismatches.
blocks.zh: 场景结构. 几何剂在 R\ mathcal{R} 中构造出根表面,作为静态相撞器,定位并引导它们与 RANSAC- 适配平面并从输入图像中推断出它们的形状和大小;它们必须满足 E sursh E\ mathrm{ surf}} 中所需的关系. 被导入的物体几何和外观仍为固定;物体只移动以纠正被测量到的接触缺陷或明显的位置不匹配.

blocks.en:
VLM agents can produce visually plausible geometry that violates support or contact constraints, such as tables intersecting walls or objects floating above surfaces. Whereas VIGA and SEIG leave all checking to the verifier, we add a deterministic check_rules gate that the editing agent must pass before verifier review.
The gate checks root placement, object support, and interpenetration, and reports the first failing level with the affected entities. It enforces a minimum geometric standard, leaving the verifier to assess visual alignment, including object placement and background geometry.
blocks.zh:
VLM剂可以产生可视可视可视的几何,违反支撑或接触约束,例如相接相接的相壁或浮于表面上方的物体. 而VIGA和SEIG则将所有检查都留给核查者,我们增加一个决定性的检查-规则门,编辑人员必须在核查者审查前通过.
大门检查根位置、对象支持和互通,并与受影响实体报告第一个故障级别。 它执行一个最低限度的几何标准,让核查者评估视觉对接,包括物体的放置和背景几何.

blocks.en: Material and lighting. Once the structure is fixed, the material agent updates only root-surface materials and textures, including color, roughness, and surface patterns. The lighting agent then adjusts illumination and exposure to match the shadows, color, and contrast of the input image. Both stages leave background geometry, object placement, and object appearance unchanged, so pose refinement operates on fixed background geometry and rendering conditions.
blocks.zh: 材料和照明。 一旦结构被固定,材料剂只更新了根地表材料和纹理,包括颜色,粗糙度和地表图案. 照明剂随后会调整照明和曝光,以相匹配输入图像的阴影,颜色和对比. 两个阶段都留下了背景几何,物体放置,以及物体外观不变,因此在固定的背景几何和渲染条件上呈现出完善.

blocks.en: 3.3 Physics-Grounded Object Pose Refinement
blocks.zh: 3.3 物理-圆形物体

blocks.en:
After reconstructing the surrounding scene, we refine the object transforms X o X_{o} to correct placement errors that remain after initialization.
A naive approach asks the VLM agent to adjust coordinates directly, e.g., by translating an object 0.05 0.05 units in scene code.
However, lacking intrinsic metric grounding, agents often hallucinate these magnitudes, causing collisions or instability.
We therefore use an investigation and editing loop in which the agent diagnoses placement errors and calls tools to search for corrections and test them in simulation.
blocks.zh:
在重建了周围的场景后,我们精炼出物体会变换出X o o o }来纠正初始化后仍然存在的放置错误.
一种天真的方法要求VLM代理直接调整坐标,例如,通过在场景代码中翻译出一个对象0.050.05单元.
然而,由于缺乏内在的尺度地基,物剂往往会幻觉出这些地貌,造成碰撞或不稳定。
因此,我们使用一个调查和编辑循环,在循环中,代理人诊断出放置错误,并调用工具来搜索更正并在模拟中测试.

blocks.en: Investigate–edit loop. A single agent session runs this loop in the persistent scene. Every object in 𝒪 \mathcal{O} must be investigated at least once, and the agent may revisit objects as their surroundings change. The Investigate tool returns paired crops from the input image and current render, geometric measurements, and support information. Using this information, the agent decides which object to adjust and whether to change its position, scale, or orientation. For example, if an object looks too small in the render, the agent checks whether to move it closer to the camera or enlarge its mesh.
blocks.zh: 调查 - 编辑循环。 单个代理会话在持续场景中运行此循环. O\ mathcal{O} 中的每个对象必须至少被调查一次, 并且当对象的周围环境发生变化时, 代理人可以重温对象 。 调查工具从输入图像和当前渲染、几何测量和辅助信息中返回成对的作物。 使用此信息,代理商决定哪个反对调整,以及是否改变其位置,规模,或方向. 例如,如果一个物体在渲染中看起来太小,代理人会检查是把它移到相机附近还是放大它的网格.

blocks.en: The agent passes the selected object and edit type to the Move tool, which supports horizontal translation, uniform scaling, and yaw adjustment. The tool determines the adjustment magnitude through bounded coarse-to-fine search, using the original pose as a baseline. Translation and scale scores combine silhouette overlap with depth; yaw combines centered silhouette overlap with DINOv2 features [ oquab2024dinov2 ] from object crops. Appendix formalizes these scores in Eq. ( ).
blocks.zh: 代理将所选对象和编辑类型传递到"移动"工具,该工具支持水平翻译,统一缩放和yaw调整. 该工具通过从粗到细的边框搜索,以原始的姿势为基线,确定调整幅度. 翻译和比例分数结合了 silhouette 重叠与深度; yaw 结合了 中心 silhouette 重叠与 DINov2 特征 [oquab2024dinov2] 来自对象作物. 附录以Eq. (.)形式正式确定这些分数.

blocks.en: Physical validation. For routine bounded moves, the Move tool then simulates the selected candidate only if it improves alignment. Physical checks reject capsize or excessive drift, and substantial new or worsened penetration. An update is retained only if these checks pass and its post-settling acceptance score matches or exceeds the baseline (Eq. ( )); otherwise, the previous state is restored. If a support moves or is resized, its dependents in E sup E_{\mathrm{sup}} are repositioned and resettled as needed.
blocks.zh: 物理鉴定. 对于常规的有边框的移动,"移动"工具之后只有在改进了对齐性的情况下才会模拟被选中的候选人. 物理检查拒绝翻转或过度漂移,以及大量新的或更严重的穿透。 只有当这些检查通过且其安置后接受分数符合或超过基准(Eq. (-))时,才保留更新;否则,恢复以前的状态。 如果支持移动或调整规模,其E sup E_{\mathrm{sup}}}中的受抚养人将根据需要重新定位并重新定居。

blocks.en: When bounded moves are insufficient, the agent can specify pose changes directly through the scene-code editing tool Edit . The tool settles affected objects in support order and returns the simulated render and physical diagnostics. The agent then decides whether to retain or undo the result. Appendix details search objectives and special cases.
blocks.zh: 当被绑定的动作不足时,代理可以通过场景码编辑工具"编辑"(Edit. 该工具按支持顺序调节受影响的对象,并返回模拟渲染和物理诊断. 然后由代理人决定是否保留或撤销结果。 附录详细介绍了搜索目标和特殊情况。

blocks.en:
Context management and prompt caching. We summarize older interaction rounds in blocks, retaining a log of actions, scores, and outcomes and replacing outdated images with references to saved artifacts.
We retain the target image, stage-entry snapshot, and recent evidence. A per-object state table sits after the cache breakpoint, so measurements, pending checks, and budgets can change without invalidating the reusable prompt prefix. In our evaluation benchmark (Sec. 4 ), 84.1% of pose-refinement input tokens are served from cache (Appendix ; Figure ).
blocks.zh:
环境管理和快速缓存。 我们以块来总结以往的互动回合,保留行动记录、评分和结果,并用已保存文物的参考文献来取而代之。
我们保留了目标图像、舞台入场快照和最近的证据。 每个对象状态表会坐落在缓存断点后,因此测量,待检查,而预算可以改变而不会使可再使用的快取前缀无效. 在我们的评价基准(Sec. 4)中,84.1%的平面精炼输入符来自缓存(附录;图 )。

blocks.en: Scene delivery and USD export. After refinement, a joint gravity simulation sets the final object transforms. We bake procedural materials and export meshes, textures, lights, and camera state to USD, preserving object identities, collision geometry, and physical properties for simulation. Appendix details conversion and simulator-side validation.
blocks.zh: 现场交货和美元出口。 经过完善后,联合重力模拟设定了最终的物体变换. 我们烤出程序材料,将网格、纹理、灯光和相机状态导出至美元,保存物体身份、相撞几何和物理特性以供模拟。 附录详细列出转换和模拟-侧验证.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare with four baselines: VIGA [ viga2026 ] , REST3D [ ma2026rest3d ] , SceneConductor [ kim2026sceneconductor ] , and SimFoundry [ simfoundry2026 ] . To support object-centric evaluation and simulation, we augment VIGA’s system prompt with a simple object-grouping contract: all parts of each movable object share a single empty Blender parent. We also evaluate SAM3D ∗ , which shares SceneRig ’s segmentation, camera, objects, and scene context but retains SAM3D’s predicted poses without our metric grounding, physical settling, or pose refinement. We use Claude Opus 5 as the default VLM wherever applicable. With GPT-6 Astra, we also compare against Codex, a general-purpose harness that reconstructs the scene directly in Blender without external models. Appendices and provide implementation details and full harness results.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们比较了四个基线:VIGA [viga2026], REST3D [ma2026rest3d], Scene conductor [kim2026scene conductor], 和 SimFoundry [ simfoundry2026]. 为了支持以对象为中心的评价和模拟,我们用一个简单的对象分组合同来增强VIGA的系统:每个可移动物体的所有部分都有一个单独的空 Blender 母体。 我们还评估SAM3D ∗,它分享了SceneRig的分片、相机、物体和场景背景,但保留了SAM3D的预测外形,而没有我们的平地、物理安放或改进。 我们使用克洛德·奥普斯5作为默认的VLM,只要适用. 与GPT-6 Astra相提并论,我们也比较了Codex,一种没有外出模型直接在Blender重建场景的通用用具. 附录并提供实施细节和充分利用成果。

blocks.en: Data. Our benchmark contains 80 tabletop images, including 44 simulator renderings from RoboDojo [ chen2026robodojo ] and RoboLab [ yang2026robolab ] with ground-truth object identities and 3D positions. The remainder comprise real robot workspace images, Internet or AI-generated images, and smartphone photos. We evaluate source-view fidelity, perceptual preference, and physical stability on all scenes, and object-centric reconstruction and 3D layout on the simulator subset.
blocks.zh: 数据。 我们的基准包含80个平面图像,包括来自RoboDojo [chen2026robodojo]和RoboLab [yang2026robolab]的44个模拟渲染器,具有地真对象身份和3D位置. 其余包括真正的机器人工作空间图像、互联网或AI生成的图像以及智能手机相片。 我们评价所有场景的源视图忠诚度、感知偏好和物理稳定性,以及模拟子集上以对象为中心的重建和3D布局。

blocks.en: Metrics. We report full-frame PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and nCLIP. Object-centric PSNR ∗ /SSIM ∗ use object regions only (exclude background and table), while LPIPS ∗ /nCLIP ∗ average the per-object crop scores. Instance metrics are adjusted Rand index (ARI), foreground IoU, and object-count MAE. For 3D layout, optimal subpattern assignment (OSPA) [ schuhmacher2008ospa ] at 5/10 cm cutoffs penalizes position errors and unmatched objects; F1@10 uses one-to-one 3D matches within 10 cm. To account for differences in scale conventions across methods, we align each reconstructed layout to ground truth using a single global scale factor before computing OSPA and F1. GPT-5.6-terra and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B compare reconstruction pairs for completeness, layout, and appearance using the input image and both candidates’ source- and nearby-view renders. We summarize preferences with mean-centered Bradley–Terry scores (inter-judge Cohen’s κ = 0.87 \kappa=0.87 ). An object passes the stability test if its displacement after 5 s is below 50 mm and its final velocity is zero; a scene passes only if every object passes. Check details in Appendices and .
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 我们报告完整的PSNR,SSIM,LPIPS,和nCLIP。 以对象为中心的 PSNR */SSIM *只使用对象区域(不包括背景和表),而LPIPS */nCLIP *平均每个对象的收分. 实例衡量标准是调整后Rand指数(ARI)、前景IoU和对象计算MAE。 对于3D布局,最佳副相分配(OSPA)[schuhmacher2008ospa]在 5/10 cm 截取时会惩罚位置错误和未匹配对象;F1@10在10 cm内使用一对一的3D匹配. 为了说明不同方法在规模惯例上的差异,我们在计算OSA和F1. GPT-5.6-terra和Qun3.5-122B-A10B之前,用单个全球尺度系数来调整每个重建的布局,以便用输入图像和候选人的源头和相邻视图来比较重建配对。 我们用中枢的 Bradley – Terry 得分(法官间 Cohen = 0.87\kappa = 0.87)来总结偏好。 如果一个物体在5 s后的位置低于50毫米而其最终速度为0,则通过稳定性测试;只有当每个物体通过时,才通过场景。 请在附录和.

blocks.en: Physics-grounded object placement. All variants in Table 4 share the same components except object placement. The SAM3D variants retain raw poses, bypassing our metric initialization, settling, and pose refinement. These poses often penetrate or float above supports; settling them for 5 s restores stability but reduces segmentation overlap and 3D placement accuracy. SceneRig ’s support-ordered settling and pose refinement improve both while preserving stability. The code-edits-only variant removes Move while retaining Edit , which simulates agent-specified pose changes and returns feedback for agent review. This variant obtains worse object-appearance and 3D-layout scores (Tables 4 and ). Removing Move reduces robot trajectory replay success from 80% to 44% (Appendix , Table ). These results highlight the effectiveness of our physics-grounded tool design.

blocks.en: VLM backbones and reconstruction harnesses. Within SceneRig , replacing Opus 5 with GPT-6 Astra substantially improves appearance but only modestly improves 3D layout (Appendix ). With a shared GPT-6 Astra backbone, SceneRig still achieves better results on most object-centric metrics, more accurate placement, and more stable scenes than VIGA and Codex (Tables 4 and ). These results show that a stronger VLM alone does not ensure accurate and stable object placement: even when all methods use the same stronger backbone, SceneRig still achieves more accurate placement and better physical stability.

Both reconstructions of each episode run the policy checkpoint used on the real robot, sharing simulator, calibration, and global simulation settings. We report success rates, episode-level agreement, and Cohen’s κ \kappa for each policy. Pearson’s r r is computed both within each policy across five tasks and across all ten policy–task pairs. blocks.en: Setup. We collect and evaluate 25 successful teleoperated demonstrations, five per task. Both SceneRig ’s and SimFoundry’s reconstructions of each episode are imported into Isaac Sim with the calibrated bimanual robot. Controllers track the measured joint trajectory and gripper commands from the recorded initial configuration, without policy queries or trajectory adaptation. Commands, calibration, gains, and physics settings are shared (Appendix ).

blocks.en: SceneRig more reliably supports open-loop trajectory replay. SceneRig successfully replays 20/25 demonstrations, versus 9/25 for SimFoundry, with higher success on every task (Table 5 ); it succeeds on every demonstration that SimFoundry replays successfully (exact McNemar p = 0.001 p=0.001 ). SimFoundry fails due to missing objects, misplaced containers, and geometry that obstructs the robot. In Figure , its fused apple–plate mesh lifts the plate when the apple is grasped, while SceneRig preserves separate objects and supports the recorded manipulation.

blocks.en: 6 \par Discussion
blocks.zh: 6\par 讨论

blocks.en: Conclusions. We present SceneRig , an agentic system that reconstructs simulation-ready scenes from single images. Its modular harness equips agents with geometric and physical tools to refine object placement through edit-and-validate loops. Across diverse tabletop scenes, SceneRig improves visual fidelity and placement accuracy while maintaining physical stability. Its scenes better predict real-world policy outcomes and more reliably reproduce recorded manipulations. These results offer a path to scaling robot policy evaluation by bringing real workspaces into simulation.
blocks.zh: 结论。 我们介绍SceneRig, 一个代理系统 重建模拟准备场景 从单一图像。 其模块化的拉带为代理人配备了几何和物理工具来通过编辑和验证回路来完善对象定位. 在整个不同的平面场景中,Scenerig在保持物理稳定性的同时,提高了视觉的忠诚度和放置的精度. 它的场景能够更好地预测现实世界的政策成果并更可靠地复制有记录的操纵. 这些结果为通过将真正的工作空间引入模拟来扩大机器人政策评价提供了一条道路.

blocks.en: Limitations and future work. Although SceneRig accurately places objects in tabletop scenes, complex room scenes remain challenging due to occlusion, depth ambiguity, and frequent contacts. SAM3D’s lack of PBR materials limits photorealism, and our current representation treats each reconstructed object as a single rigid body and does not recover joint structures or deformation. Future work will explore improved depth estimation and image-to-3D models.
blocks.zh: 限制和今后的工作。 虽然SceneRig精确地将物体放入平面场景,但由于被隐蔽,深度模糊,频繁接触,复杂的房间场景仍然具有挑战性. SAM3D缺乏PBR材料限制了光现实主义,我们目前的表述将每一个被重建的物体作为单一的刚性体来对待,不会恢复联合结构或变形. 今后的工作将探索改进深度估计和图像到-3D模型。

Occlusion completion. Preprocessing invokes generative resegmentation after segmentation; its

A separate crop check for each instance estimates visibility and frame truncation and identifies missing structural parts, such as a handle or base. These judgments feed a deterministic recovery policy. Self-occlusion is not a missing external part. A supporting ancestor will not be treated as an occluder of its descendant. Completion is considered for a missing structural part, visibility below 75 % 75\%\par , or an overlap-separation loss of at least 150 pixels or 3 % 3\%\par of the target mask.

blocks.en:
Object assets and physical properties. SAM3D [ 6 ] reconstructs a textured mesh from the
full-frame image and the instance mask. Its predicted orientation is transformed into the gravity-aligned frame without reflection. The mesh is centered at the metric position and uniformly scaled by the depth-projected 3D points of that object after outlier filtering. SHARP renders can contain holes, haze, or stretched edges. Thus, we use GPT-Image-2 to edit
each rendered image with instructions to repair these artifacts while preserving
clear content and viewpoint. This is a mask-free edit of the rendered view,
not a text-only request for a new angle and not a paired input-photo edit.
We do not composite original pixels back into the generated result. To detect

The edit is rejected if the mean absolute difference over the remaining

source-view reference is always the original photograph. The lighting stage
uses only that real source view, since generated illumination is not reliable
evidence for lighting estimation.

shapes. Supports and containers receive finer decomposition to preserve
interior cavities. The validated decomposition is reused during pose
refinement and export when the mesh differs only by a recoverable transform;
geometry changes trigger rebuilding. A persistent PhysX scene processes
objects in parent-before-child order under E sup E_{\mathrm{sup\par}} , with larger
footprints prioritized where dependencies permit. This order applies to
initial placement, not the pose agent’s investigation sequence. Temporary
root slabs provide support until the initialization agent builds
root geometry.

blocks.en:
Each object is first dropped against its support context, then against the
already placed scene. It is released 2 mm above collision-free contact and
simulated with all six rigid-body degrees of freedom. For a non-rollable
object, excessive tilt triggers a recovery ladder: try the canonical upright
mesh orientation, then a guarded physical-property adjustment. The adjustment
can flatten a narrow collider base band, move or lower the center of mass,
and increase friction and damping, with matching inertia. A sliver-like
contact footprint disables this adjustment to avoid manufacturing an implausible
balancing pose. If no upright candidate works, the actual fallen resting pose
is retained and flagged. Rollable objects instead use horizontal displacement
to detect instability; rolling in place is allowed, and center-of-mass
stabilization is skipped. Small lateral searches address collisions with
neighbors, and a bounded inward nudge can move an object off its support’s rim.

blocks.en:
After settling, trimmed iterative closest point (ICP) alignment fits the mesh
to the masked metric points. It optimizes horizontal translation, yaw, and
uniform scale about the object’s bottom center; the fitted vertical offset is
discarded so simulation determines resting height. The correction must reduce
point-to-mesh RMS error by at least 20 % 20\%\par . Scale is fixed for equal-size or
otherwise scale-locked assets. ICP is skipped after a successful rim or
wrong-support escape, where fitting the original points would undo the rescue.
A correction needing more than 3 cm of collision clearance is rejected.
Otherwise, another drop tests convergence and class-appropriate stability;
failure restores the exact pre-ICP pose. An already fallen object is not
rejected merely for retaining that same attitude. Accepted collision shapes
remain in the scene for subsequent objects. After all objects are placed,
a final joint pass releases every object at once in a single free simulation
run to rest; the resulting small drift is baked into the saved poses and
recorded per object before the scene is imported into Blender.

Both receive the allowed edits for that stage, the object and root-surface

Blender scene through a stage-entry snapshot and scene-inspection tools.
The snapshot exposes object names, transforms, dimensions, materials, lights,
and camera state; the graph supplies stable IDs, supports, descriptions, and
root-plane evidence. A stage-specific prompt states which of these quantities
may change. The original image remains the visual anchor.

not a reset scene; initialization also carries forward its construction plan.
Feedback from unrelated stages is not repeatedly inserted into the prompt.
Budgets bound this loop. Reaching a budget without approval produces a
best-effort artifact sent to the subsequent stage. Figure B.3 \par Agentic scene construction shows the shared-scene progression.

an orthogonal basis. Roots lacking reliable planes are

relation calls for connected legs or a base reaching the floor, rather than

Every registered root must be represented. Openings can be cut into a wall,
with small frame or glass details attached to that wall. A dedicated
root-creation tool can register a genuinely missing architectural wall, and
only such runtime-added roots can be removed through the corresponding tool.
The agent cannot silently delete a preprocessed root or create duplicate
unregistered walls. One auxiliary level ground is allowed when needed.
Root collision geometry is static, with predefined friction. Coarse materials
and lighting are initialized once before later appearance refinement.

Imported object poses are the trusted starting point. Initialization may
translate an object or support stack only through a controlled correction
tool, in response to a measured contact defect or a clear position mismatch
in paired images. It cannot rotate, resize, remesh, or retexture the object.
The correction tool tests object integrity, support, and new or worsened collisions, rolls back a failed correction, and requires another rule check after success.
Moving an object merely to compensate for a wrongly built support is disallowed.

The appearance stage changes root materials and textures τ r \tau_{r} , including

and object assets fixed. The illumination stage changes lights, world
illumination, exposure, and view-transform settings, not materials or layout.
It compares only source-view renders with the input image. The source camera stays fixed; alternate views use rendering tools rather than camera edits.

blocks.en:
Rule checks and visual feedback. As a special tool for the initialization stage only, the read-only check_rules tool evaluates three levels in sequence. Structure checks
verify imported-object integrity, registered-root coverage, main-support
geometry, top height, and required structural relations. Pose checks compare
root silhouettes with the reference masks and verify that all objects rest on their supports. Contact checks detect penetration, floating objects, and violated surface relations. Advisory relations do not acquire the force of required constraints. The report identifies the first failing level and its affected entities; later levels are not evaluated and must not be assumed to pass.

核查进口物体的完整性、注册根覆盖、主要支持

blocks.en:
The initialization generator revises the scene and reruns the tool after
edits. Its voluntary completion requires a current pass and verifier approval. For ambiguous or tiny wall masks, an explicit visibility exception can waive an unreliable mask comparison, but not the requirement to build the root. Passing numerical rules establishes a minimum geometric standard, not visual faithfulness: the verifier still judges table edges, wall placement, gaps, and visible structure. Appearance and lighting have their own visual verifiers without this initialization rule ladder. Their feedback targets root-surface appearance and source-view lighting, respectively.

Bounded candidate search. The agent selects an object and a move aspect a a from six choices: horizontal translation along x x , along y y , or jointly in x ​ y xy ; uniform scaling; yaw adjustment; or a 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} yaw flip. The flip follows the special procedure described below. For routine bounded moves, the agent does not specify the adjustment magnitude or search direction.
The Move tool evaluates a coarse candidate set and then finer candidates around the winner. Translation step sizes are proportional to object size, so larger objects are tested with larger shifts. For joint x x – y y moves, the tool compares the rendered object mask with the reference mask and uses their offset to propose a translation. Scale and yaw searches can similarly use measured size and orientation differences to propose candidates. Before rendering each candidate, the tool resolves overlap with the support and adjusts the object’s height to place it on the geometry below. These geometric placement operations do not run a physics simulation. Candidates are ranked using the alignment scores below; only the selected candidate proceeds to physical settling and acceptance checks.

blocks.en: When bounded moves repeatedly fail or cannot express a correction, the code-edit tool Edit allows direct layout changes, including coordinated edits. The scene-code editing tool detects changed objects, resolves initial overlaps, and settles affected supports before their dependents in simulation. It then returns the post-simulation render and physical diagnostics for the agent to decide whether to retain or undo the simulated result. Automatic alignment and physical acceptance checks govern bounded moves; the agent decides whether to retain simulated code edits. If the required simulation fails to execute, the raw edit is rolled back. Undo restores the pre-edit scene snapshot rather than using approximate inverse transforms.

separate an edit from its undo, so the recent window can occasionally grow

It records the latest measured scores, completed or pending follow-up checks, tool-use counts, rejected aspects, and exhausted budgets. The table and remaining-round budget sit after the cache breakpoint, at the changing end of the prompt. Their updates therefore preserve the reusable prefix. REST3D and source-camera recovery. We evaluate REST3D’s final object reconstruction after its scene assembly and

slab is added because the raw floor reference is omitted from the final object

If either camera cannot define this intersection, each set instead uses the centroid of all objects’ positions projected onto the support plane. For both predictions and ground truth, object positions are defined by world-space axis-aligned bounding-box centers and then transformed into the canonical frame.
All predicted objects contribute to the metric, including unmatched extras. We evaluate object arrangement up to a global scale factor, allowing comparison across reconstruction methods with different scale conventions.

blocks.en:
Direct Codex harness with GPT-6 Astra. Codex [ 29 ] is OpenAI’s general-purpose coding-agent meta-harness: it gives the model shell and file tools but no task-specific structure.
For the direct Codex baseline in Table D.1 \par Ablation Studies , we attach
each benchmark image to an isolated GPT-6 Astra session with ultra reasoning effort. We automate the runs through the non-interactive codex exec interface, using the prompt shown in Listing . The agent writes Blender Python, runs Blender headlessly, inspects rendered images, and iteratively refines the camera, geometry, materials, lighting, and composition. Each worker uses Blender 4.5.3 with Cycles on one assigned CUDA GPU, with a six-hour timeout per attempt and at most two attempts per image. Filesystem isolation prevents access to other scene workspaces and reconstruction results. The prompt prohibits external models, textures, images, and assets, and requires a final-render inspection followed by at least one refinement pass. It also requires one semantically labeled top-level Empty per independently movable object, with all of that object’s parts grouped beneath it, so that each object can be simulated as a single rigid body; environment geometry, cameras, and lights have separate roots. Required outputs are a procedural scene.py , a self-contained final.blend , its rendered final.png , and a report.json describing reconstruction decisions and known mismatches.
